title: Keep custom OpenAPI transformations working after an upgrade
goal: Recompile ASP.NET Core document, operation and schema transformers against the resolved OpenAPI.NET model, preserving interface-based traversal, references and JSON extension values.

selectionNotes: This is the ASP.NET Core transitive-dependency migration, not a standalone OpenAPI.NET feature catalogue. The official breaking-change article uses illustrative older Any/Models snippets that do not match this pinned .NET 10 dependency. Actual restored 2.12.2 and 3.10.2 APIs govern the comparison. Newer reference metadata can carry a summary, but the sample needs only the existing description. The 503 declaration documents a possible failure; these successful handlers do not implement or emit a 503. Reference traversal must retain the intended local/external scope. No binary-compatibility promise is made for an unrecompiled third-party transformer.
